Tracker, step by step

How to look up a plate, record a sighting, hand a record to a teammate, and navigate to where a vehicle was seen.

Screenshots use sample data and a phone-sized screen. The red banner shows while the app is in test mode. Your own screen will list your neighborhood's vehicles.

Sign inThe home screenSearch a plate while you typeOpen a vehicle and navigateTurn location on or offRecent tabAdd a vehicle with whatever you knowHand it offMenu and manual search

Step 1 · Once per phone

Sign in

Open the app link on your phone. Enter your name, so every sighting you save carries it, and paste the access token an admin gave you. Tap Sign in.

The token stays on this phone. You do not sign in again unless you log out.

Add the page to your home screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen) so it opens like an app.

Step 2 · Everything starts here

The home screen

  • Plate box at the top: type a plate, pick a state if you know it.
  • Nearby list: vehicles seen close to you, closest first. The colored circle is the flag (red confirmed, orange suspected). The right side shows distance and how long ago it was seen.
  • Take photo bar at the bottom opens the phone camera. It is on every screen.
  • Pin icon top left is the location switch. Menu is top right.

Step 3 · Two characters is enough

Search a plate while you type

Matching plates appear under the box as you type. Each plate is listed once, with the state, the plate in large type, and the vehicle below it. The characters you typed are highlighted.

  • Exact matches come first, then partial matches in alphabetical order.
  • The state chips (All, CA, NV) filter the list. Plates with no state are under State unknown.
  • Tap a row to open that vehicle. Tap Clear to return to Nearby.
  • Typing a full plate and pressing Enter opens the vehicle directly when it is the only exact match.

Partial lists help spot patterns, such as several plates that differ by one character.

Step 4 · Check history, then go there

Open a vehicle and navigate

  • Navigate to last seen location opens directions in Apple Maps on iPhone and iPad, and Google Maps elsewhere. It uses the newest sighting that has a location.
  • Share this record copies a link that opens this vehicle for someone else.
  • Recent sightings lists every report, newest first. Each one with a location has its own Map link.
  • Below the history is the update form: change the flag, add notes, photos, or the current location, then Save update.

Step 5 · The pin icon, top left

Turn location on or off

  • Green: the app reads your position and keeps Nearby up to date as you move.
  • Grey: the app does not read or ask for your position. Nearby uses the last position it had, and the header says how long ago that was.
  • While off, you are asked about location only when you save a record.
  • Tap the pin to switch it back on and Nearby refreshes itself.

Step 6 · Works with location off

Recent tab

Switch from Nearby to Recent to see the latest sightings across the neighborhood, whatever your position. With location off and no saved position, the app opens on Recent. Refresh reloads the list.

Step 7 · Nothing is required

Add a vehicle with whatever you know

Menu, then Add vehicle (no photo), or tap Take photo to start from a picture.

  • Every field is optional: color, make, model, body style, features, plate, notes.
  • You need at least one thing: a plate, note, photo, description, or your location.
  • Blank fields are saved as unknown. The record is called Unknown vehicle until someone adds details.
  • Attach my location is ticked by default. It is rounded to about 11 m.

Tap Save vehicle. No signal? It saves on the phone and uploads when you are back online.

Step 8 · Field person to desk person

Hand it off

After saving, tap Share this record and send the link by text or chat. The second person opens it, adds the plate, make, color or photos in the update form, and can tap Navigate to reach the spot.

The newest details always show first in the history, and every entry carries the name of who saved it.

Step 9 · Top right

Menu and manual search

  • Add vehicle (no photo): open the form.
  • Nearby (manual location): search around a place you type in, or use your location once. The position is used for this search only.
  • Use classic home screen: the older layout with four large buttons.
  • Sync now uploads anything waiting. Log out removes the token from this phone.
